claims.statement: The F-gas Regulation prohibits using Annex I gases with GWP of 2,500 or more to service air-conditioning equipment and heat pumps from 1 January 2026, subject to time-limited reclaimed and recycled-gas exceptions, and sets further restrictions for refrigeration.

EU implementation rules expanded mandatory technician certification to equipment using relevant alternatives, including natural refrigerants, while European shortages include air-conditioning and refrigeration mechanics.
Batching surveys, procurement, and certified service across small sites may convert scarce specialist time into a scalable coordination margin, but technician economics are unknown.

contrary_evidence: Reclaimed and recycled refrigerant exceptions delay some replacement urgency, and several broader prohibitions do not arrive until 2030 or 2032.
Competent refrigeration contractors already advise customers and may resist an intermediary.
Natural-refrigerant retrofits can involve safety, building, and capex constraints that prevent a standardized solution.

economics.acquisition_route: Offer a deadline checker inside a wholesaler or contractor quote workflow: entering a refrigerant and asset type returns the applicable risk window and, with customer consent, creates a paid portfolio-audit lead. A second channel is a standardized multi-site report sold through facilities managers at annual budget-setting time.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A maintained asset-compatibility and retrofit-cost library, pooled equipment purchasing, certified technician availability, and standardized before/after documentation reduce both planning effort and repeat visits. Network capacity and procurement leverage, not merely the asset database, drive defensibility.
fingerprint.customer: Multi-site food retailers, cold stores, restaurant groups, pharmacies, and hospitality operators with legacy refrigeration, air-conditioning, or heat-pump assets but no in-house refrigerant transition manager.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Offer a deadline checker inside a wholesaler or contractor quote workflow: entering a refrigerant and asset type returns the applicable risk window and, with customer consent, creates a paid portfolio-audit lead. A second channel is a standardized multi-site report sold through facilities managers at annual budget-setting time.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Capture nameplate and service records through a guided mobile survey; map each asset to leak-check, certification, service-ban, and replacement deadlines; produce total-cost scenarios; pool procurement; and tender the work to certified technicians. The company manages evidence and projects but does not perform regulated refrigerant work unless separately certified.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The operator pays per site for an asset-and-refrigerant risk survey, then a fixed project-management fee on an approved batch retrofit or replacement and an annual fee for compliance records and deadline monitoring.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A leak, service quote, unavailable refrigerant, insurance review, acquisition, or approaching use/placing-on-market restriction forces a portfolio owner to decide what can be maintained, retrofitted, reclaimed, or replaced.

founder_fit: Good fit with structured data capture, lifecycle modelling, automation, and family exposure to installation operations.
Can launch with low fixed capital as a portfolio desk while subcontracting certification-dependent fieldwork.
The founder must learn safety and refrigerant rules deeply and avoid representing analytical output as certified engineering.
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: F-Gas Transition Portfolio Desk for Small Cold Assets
uncertainties: Size and refrigerant composition of addressable Polish small-asset portfolios.
Owner willingness to pay separately for planning rather than obtain advice within a contractor quote.
Whether wholesaler quote-flow integration is available and compliant with customer-consent rules.
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: Survey 100 assets at three multi-site operators, have two independent certified contractors price the same risk-ranked plan, and charge at least two operators for the portfolio report. Proceed only if the desk finds material deadline or cost errors, produces comparable bids, and secures one paid batch project without taking regulated work in-house.
